D2: No canonical 'Deployed contracts' / 'Addresses' page found on lulo.fi/docs. The docs sidebar lists Overview, How It Works, Protection, The Index, Security, and Developers sections — none link to a deployments address list. protocol_metadata.deployed_contracts_doc set to null.

D3: Audit page at lulo.fi/docs/audits lists 5 audits (Certora, Halborn, OtterSec, Offside Labs, Sec3) with Google Drive PDF links. All links require auth or render as Drive previews not fetchable as raw content. No in-scope contract addresses extracted from audit PDFs this run. Recorded in unknowns.

D6: No factory pattern identified. Lulo uses per-token pool accounts. The USDC pool account is enumerated in Anchor.toml. DeFiPunkd API does not support Solana chainId; on-chain reads for factory children not possible this run.

D7: Role taxonomy applied: Lulo V2 Program = other (Solana program ID); Pool account = pool; Protocol authority = admin; Protected mint = token; Regular mint = token; Pool input token account = vault; Protocol token account = vault; Default referrer wallet = other; Default referrer pool_user = other.

protocol_metadata.about: Lulo is a Solana-native stablecoin yield aggregator that automatically distributes user deposits across leading lending protocols (Kamino, Jupiter on Solana; Morpho, Maple, Pendle on Ethereum) weighted by TVL and lending rate. It offers two products: Protected (stable yield with automated smart-contract-level coverage against protocol failures, no claim required) and Boost (higher yield in exchange for underwriting the coverage system as a first-loss layer). The protocol is non-custodial, with every position recorded on-chain, and has been independently audited five times by Certora, Halborn, OtterSec, Offside Labs, and Sec3.
